facts.text: The hotel describes its location as the most glamorous destination on the Italian Adriatic coast.
facts.excerpt: Masseria Torre Maizza is located in the most glamorous destination on the Italian Adriatic coast.

facts.text: The hotel blends local heritage with contemporary luxury.
facts.excerpt: it exquisitely blends local heritage with contemporary luxury

facts.text: Junior suites combine the masseria's original features, including a vaulted ceiling, with contemporary design accents.
facts.excerpt: our junior suites marry the Masseria’s original features, including a stunning vaulted ceiling, with contemporary design accents.

facts.text: Rooms have king-sized beds and stone bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: The spacious rooms feature sumptuous king-sized beds, stone bathrooms, and all manner of state-of-the-art amenities.

facts.text: Forte Suites have views over the Puglian countryside out to the Adriatic.
facts.excerpt: An exclusive havens offering sensational views over a sweeping expanse of Puglian countryside, out to the blue-green Adriatic beyond.

facts.text: Suites pair interiors in natural shades with expansive private gardens.
facts.excerpt: our suitse pairs elegant interiors in a serene palette of natural shades with expansive private gardens.

facts.text: Borgo degli Ulivi is a group of interconnected rooms for up to 22 guests, suited to family getaways or group retreats with friends.
facts.excerpt: Borgo degli Ulivi for up to 22 guests, perfect for family getaways or group retreats with friends. Your private Puglian palace with stunning interconnected rooms

facts.text: Borgo degli Ulivi's Grand Suites have private gardens and pools.
facts.excerpt: four magnificent Grand Suites with a private gardens and pools

facts.text: The Bougainvillea bar is set under the whitewashed arches of the masseria's 16th-century barn and was reimagined by Olga Polizzi.
facts.excerpt: Under the whitewashed arches of what was once the Masseria’s 16th-century barn, find our serene, spacious bar, reimagined by Olga Polizzi.

facts.text: Carosello restaurant is set in the masseria's former stables, with whitewashed ceilings, rustic pews and garden views.
facts.excerpt: Set in the former stables of the Masseria, Carosello’s high, whitewashed ceilings, rustic pews and garden views combine for an elegant, authentic ambience.

facts.text: The hotel's beach club, Lido Bambù, is in Capitolo, south of Monopoli, with white sands on the Adriatic.
facts.excerpt: Lido Bambù is located in one of the most beautiful places in Puglia south of Monopoli, in Capitolo with a backdrop of white sands and the soothing sound of the crystal-clear Adriatic sea.

facts.text: A hotel shuttle service takes guests to the Lido Bambù beach club.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel shuttle service is available to take you to our welcoming, pet-friendly beach club.

facts.text: The Lido Bambù beach club is pet-friendly.
At Lido Bambù guests can have a sunset aperitivo accompanied by live music.
facts.excerpt: an aperitivo at sunset accompanied by live music

facts.text: Summer experiences include a private yacht excursion along the Adriatic coast.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a private yacht excursion along the Adriatic coast

facts.text: Summer experiences include a picnic beneath centuries-old olive trees.
facts.excerpt: relax with a charming picnic beneath centuries-old olive trees.

facts.text: The Irene Forte Spa fuses the regenerative powers of nature and science.
facts.excerpt: Revive your mind and body in our Irene Forte Spa, where we fuse the regenerative powers of nature and science.
